q: How many seconds are there in a year?
how: 60 × 60 × 24 × 365 = 3.15 crore, about 32 million. A handy number: π × 10⁷ is close.

q: How many seconds long is one NSE equity session, from 9:15 am to 3:30 pm?
how: 6¼ hours × 3,600 seconds = 22,500.

q: How many minutes does the NSE equity market trade in a year?
how: 375 minutes a day × about 250 trading days = 93,750.

q: Roughly how many trading days are there in 30 years?
how: About 250 trading days a year (weekdays less holidays) × 30 = 7,500.

q: How many ₹500 notes make ₹1 crore?
how: ₹1 crore is ₹1,00,00,000. Divide by 500: 20,000 notes.

q: How many rupees is one basis point on ₹100 crore?
how: A basis point is 0.01%. ₹100 crore × 0.0001 = ₹1 lakh.

q: A company worth ₹10 lakh crore moves 1%. How many rupees of value is that?
how: 1% of ₹10 lakh crore is ₹10,000 crore, which is 10¹¹ rupees (100 billion).

q: How many litres of water does an Olympic swimming pool hold?
how: 50 m × 25 m × 2 m deep = 2,500 cubic metres, and each holds 1,000 litres: 25 lakh litres (2.5 million). Deeper pools hold more.

q: How many times does a heart beat in a 70-year life?
how: About 70 beats a minute × 60 × 24 × 365 × 70 years ≈ 2.6 billion (260 crore).

q: How many breaths does an adult take in a day?
how: About 15 breaths a minute at rest × 1,440 minutes = 21,600.

q: How many grains of rice are in a 1 kg bag?
how: A grain of milled rice weighs roughly 20 to 25 mg, so 1,000 g ÷ 0.022 g ≈ 45,000.

q: How many words are in a 300-page novel?
how: About 300 words a page × 300 pages = 90,000.

q: How many days old is someone on their 30th birthday?
how: 30 × 365 = 10,950, plus 7 or 8 leap days: about 10,957.

q: How many people could stand packed onto a football pitch?
how: 105 m × 68 m ≈ 7,100 square metres, at about 4 people a square metre: roughly 28,000.

q: How many cricket balls would fill a room 4 m by 4 m by 3 m?
how: The room is 48 cubic metres. A ball is about 7.2 cm across, so about 195 cubic cm. Balls fill about 64% of the space: 48,000,000 × 0.64 ÷ 195 ≈ 1.6 lakh.

q: ₹1 lakh crore written out in rupees: what number is it?
how: A lakh is 10⁵ and a crore is 10⁷, so a lakh crore is 10¹²: one trillion rupees.

q: How many people live in India?
how: About 146 crore (1.46 billion), the most of any country, by the UN's estimate for 2025.

q: How many UPI payments are made in India in a month?
how: October 2025 set a record: 2,070 crore payments (20.7 billion), about 67 crore a day. A Fermi path: tens of crores of users making a payment or two a day.

q: How many demat accounts are there in India?
how: About 21 crore across CDSL and NSDL by October 2025. Many investors hold more than one, so it is more than the number of investors.

q: How many mutual fund folios are there in India?
how: About 25.6 crore in October 2025. A folio is one investor's account with one fund house, so one person often has several.

q: How many passenger vehicles (cars, SUVs and vans) are sold in India in a year?
how: A record 43 lakh in 2024-25, by SIAM's count of sales to dealers.

q: How many tonnes of milk does India produce in a year?
how: 239.3 million tonnes in 2023-24, the most of any country: about 65 crore kg a day.

q: How many ATMs are there in India?
how: 2,51,057 at the end of March 2025, slightly fewer than a year before as UPI took over small payments.

q: How many passengers does Indian Railways carry in a day?
how: About 2.3 crore (23 million) a day, close to the population of Australia.
